meta.name: novel-to-game
meta.description: Turn a novel into a fully playable game on the selected target platform. Orchestrates the whole adaptation pipeline — requirements intake, gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and visual design, target-runtime build, and evidence-based QA — for a novel in any language. Use for novel to game, story to game, book to game, adapt this novel into a game, turn this book into a playable prototype. NovelToGame 总入口。把任意语言的原始小说、拆文库或 oh-story 写作工程转成有原著依据、可在目标平台完整游玩的游戏，编排游戏化拆解、概念选择、游戏与视觉设计、目标运行环境构建和证据化质量验证。用于小说转游戏、把这本书做成游戏等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把小说改编成可在目标平台游玩的游戏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有小说想变成可玩的游戏
copy.tagline_en: Turn a novel into a playable game on your target platform.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a novel and want to make it a playable game.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把指定小说或写作工程编排成完整改编流程：先做需求确认并生成产品简报，再依次产出原著依据、游戏概念、设计、美术、构建和测试报告，每步过门后才进入下一步，最终交付可在目标平台游玩的游戏。
howto.when: 当用户提供原始小说、拆文库或 oh-story 工程，并要求改编成游戏时触发；也可说“把这本书做成游戏”等。

say.text: 把整本《三体》改成一个能在网页里玩的游戏
say.note: 触发快速模式，自动比较三个概念后完成全流程。

say.text: 用 director 模式改编我的小说，做成 PC 客户端
say.note: 给出三个概念和推荐后等你选择。

say.text: 从上次停下的地方继续这个小说转游戏项目
say.note: 读取进度，核对产物后从最早未过门的阶段继续。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates the whole novel-to-game pipeline: requirements intake to PRODUCT_BRIEF.md, then deconstruction, concept, design, build, QA; each stage gates before next, ending in a playable game on the chosen platform.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a novel, story, book, deconstruction library or oh-story project and asks to turn it into a game (e.g., 'adapt this novel into a game'). Modes: quick, director, resume.

say_en.text: Turn the whole novel 'The Three-Body Problem' into a playable web game.
say_en.note: Starts quick mode: compares three concepts then completes the pipeline.

say_en.text: Use director mode to adapt my novel into a PC client game.
say_en.note: Stops after showing three concepts and recommendation for you to choose.

say_en.text: Resume the previous novel-to-game project from where it stopped.
say_en.note: Reads _progress.md, verifies artifacts, continues from earliest unpassed gate.
